artifacts.summary: 11-phase plan (13.5h) extending C17's counting rule (1,020 -> 771 plus a 47-row Boneyard sub-count), reconciling the import-orphan finding with C6's existing manifest, dispositioning all 771 post-filter survivors, and executing only the 81 def deletions in three verified batches.

memory_candidates.content: Before planning a new repo-health check proposed by research, verify no existing check already computes the same property. In BimodalLogic, a research report recommended adding an import-reachability check for 10 orphan modules on the grounds that 'nothing currently reports it'; C6 in scripts/check-module-invariants.sh already seeds a reachability walk from every lakefile.toml lean_lib/lean_exe root, fails on an unreachable module absent from scripts/module-invariants-manifest.txt, and all 10 modules were already listed there. A duplicate check would have tripped C6's own stale-manifest branch. The general pattern: a finding phrased as 'nothing measures X' is a hypothesis about the instrument set, cheap to falsify with one grep of the existing harness, and worth falsifying before it becomes a plan phase. The salvageable residue is usually narrower than the proposal (here: the declaration count behind the orphan modules, added to the existing check's INFO line rather than as a new check).
